claim_under_test: The current H-WP-02 reference-ledger idempotency path is sufficient for concurrent duplicate writers.
counterexample: Two writers can both miss the same idempotency key before lock acquisition. After writer A commits, writer B acquires the write lock and attempts the same UNIQUE idempotency insert without a second lookup, yielding IntegrityError rather than deterministic idempotent replay handling.
falsifier_scope: Concurrency-safety of the pre-lock-only idempotency pattern; does not refute single-writer correctness, deterministic hashing, snapshot restore or the existing 7-test local receipt.
repair_hypothesis: Move or repeat idempotency validation inside the BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and validate event identity/fingerprint before returning replay status.
repair_probe_result: A post-lock lookup in the same deterministic interleaving returns IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY and preserves one committed row.
promotion_rule: Do not mark H-WP-02 COMPLETE until the actual reference-ledger implementation is patched and a real concurrent project-host regression plus prior suites pass.
